enable_wipe.description: Whether to enable the wipe operation.

random_source.description: Path to the random device or command used to seed the PRNG.

random_method.description: Single character method for random seed: r (file/device), c (command), p (env/proc).

quick_passes.description: Number of passes for quick wipe.

keep_files.description: Do not unlink files after overwriting (implies skip name wipe).

abort_on_error.description: Exit with failure on non-fatal error.

skip_size_wipe.description: Do not try to wipe file sizes by repeatedly halving.

skip_name_wipe.description: Do not try to wipe file names by renaming.

exact_size.description: Use exact file size without rounding up to last block.

wipe_paths.description: List of file or block device paths to wipe.
